 Order

(Dated this the 5th day of November, 2025) This petition is filed by the petitioner for transfer of OP (MV) No.1825/2018 pending on the file of MACT, Attingal to MACT, Thiruvananthapuram, where the OP (MV) No.1740/2020 is pending.
2. Heard the learned Counsel for the petitioner and the learned Standing Counsel for the 6 th respondent, Insurance Company.
Other respondents served but unrepresented.

3. It is submitted by the learned counsel for the petitioner, that petitioner's husband, Biju S. was dead in a road traffic accident, therefore she has filed a claim petition under Section 166 of Motor Vehicles Act, 1988, pending before the MACT, Thiruvananthapuram in OP (MV) No.1740/2020.

Later the petitioner came to know that the parents and siblings of her deceased husband also filed a petition, i.e., OP (MV) No.1825/2018, which was pending 2025:KER:85047 before the MACT,

sentences.text: Therefore, prayed for transferring the OP (MV) No.1825/2018 from MACT, Attingal to MACT, Thiruvananthapuram.
4. The learned Standing Counsel appearing for the Insurance company submits that there are two rival claims, one by the petitioner wife and another by the parents and siblings of the deceased.
The petitioner already impleaded as additional respondent in OP (MV) No.1825/2018 which was allowed by the trial court.
Therefore, the petitioner as well as the parents of the deceased have filed two rival claim petitions.
But the petitioner herein already a party in OP (MV) No.1825/2018.
She cannot file one more petition OP (MV) No.1740/2020.
Therefore, prayed for dismissing the petition.
5. Having heard the arguments and perused records.

On perusal of the arguments addressed by the learned counsel for the petitioner that the petitioner also filed OP (HMA) No.2340/2019 before the Family Court, 2025:KER:85047 Thiruvananthapuram, to declare as she is the wife of the deceased Biju S.
The said petition is still pending (It was dismissed by default.
A restoration petition is said to be filed which is pending).
And the petitioner is required to get the decree from the Family Court to declare that she is the legally wedded wife of the deceased Biju.
However, that has to be considered by the MACT while awarding the Compensation and apportionment of the compensation.

However,
the petitioner cannot file two claims for compensation in the OP (MV) No.1825/2018 as well as OP (MV) No.1740/2020.

When the petitioner already impleaded as a party in OP (MV) No.1825/18, she may agitate and get the compensation in the OP(MV)No.1825/ 18 itself and she cannot claim compensation independently in another petition.
6.

Apart from that, as per the judgment of this High Court in a transfer petition, Amina Beevi vs.
Sonu R. Jose, Tr.P (C) No.283/2023, in the said judgment the 2025:KER:85047 coordinate Bench of this Court has stated that the subsequent petition shall be transferred to the place where the previous petition is pending and cannot be transferred the previous case to the court where subsequent case is pending.

entities.text:
Amina Beevi vs.
Sonu R. Jose, Tr.P (C) No.283/2023
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Therefore, the contention of the petitioner cannot be acceptable for transfer of OP (MV) No.1825/2018 from MACT, Attingal to MACT, Thiruvanathapuram to try along with OP (MV) No.1740/2020.
On the other hand, OP (MV) No.1740/2020 is a subsequent petition which filed after 2 years of the petition filed by her alleged in-laws.
Therefore, her petition has to be transferred to the MACT, Attingal.

Instead of transferring the OP (MV)No.1825/18, the respondent is at liberty to move the application for dismissing any one of the petition as there should not be duplication and there shall not be two claim petitions by the same petitioner, One individually in OP (MV) No.1740/2020 and collectively with the other claimants as respondent in OP (MV)No.1825/2018.
2025:KER:85047 7.
Accordingly, the transfer petition is allowed in part.

The prayer for transferring OP (MV)
No.1825/2018 from MACT, Attingal to MACT, Thiruvananthapuram is hereby rejected.
The OP(MV) No.1740/2020 pending on the file of MACT, Thiruvananthapuram is hereby withdrawn and transferred to MACT, Attingal, to try along with OP(MV)No.1825/2018.
